confidence_model: RAW research-grade registry data compiled by GEM (their sourcing notes are preserved per feature). HYPOTHESES (gate-locked): (1) mine boundaries x FIRMS/S1/S2 = mine-activity proxies; (2) Parent Company / ParentEntityIDs = the equity join spine into the entity graph (GEOT ownership tracker is the richer follow-up); (3) pipeline FID/status by parent = capex-cycle features; (4) finance-tracker financier networks. Nothing traded until ladder gates; geometry joins need gate-1 vs known mine activity first.
